sources.excerpt: Fuzzy Wooly Bear Published on October 9, 2005 Greer Amps fuzz pedal Information Nick Greer Amplification The Fuzzy Wooly Bear is a unique fuzz/overdrive pedal. Can be ordered either with a germanium or silicon transistor. The germanium version gives you the typical germanium voiced fuzz tones, but with a volume and bias control you can really tailor the tone from singing to ratty fuzz bomb! The silicon version is more aggressive, and features volume and gain controls. A bit less sweet, and a little more snarl and rudeness. Knobs: Volume, Gain or Bias Features: True Bypass, LED Size: 2 5/16" Wide, 4 1/2" Long, 1 1/4" Tall
